more.def: A female child or young woman.
examples: The girl next door taught me how to play chess.
A group of girls was singing in the school choir.
She was a shy girl who loved to read.

more.def: To hand something to someone, or to let them have it.
examples: Please give your paper to the teacher.
My grandmother gave me a scarf that she knitted.
We give water to the plants every morning.
